evals.name: Slices work vertically instead of horizontally
evals.prompt: I have a spec for a task management app with these features: user registration, login, task CRUD, and task assignment. Break this into implementation tasks.
evals.expected_output: The model should slice vertically (one complete user flow per task) rather than horizontally (all DB, then all API, then all UI), building foundations first.
assertions: The output maps dependencies between components (schema, API, UI) before listing tasks.
The output organizes tasks as vertical slices where each task delivers working, testable functionality end-to-end.
The output does NOT group all database work, then all API work, then all UI work as separate phases.
Each task includes specific, testable acceptance criteria (not just 'implement the feature').

evals.name: Decomposes a large feature into smaller tasks
evals.prompt: Break down 'add search to my app' into implementation tasks. The search needs full-text search, filters, and pagination.
evals.expected_output: The model should decompose this into 3-5 smaller tasks, each with clear scope and acceptance criteria, rather than treating it as one task.
assertions: The output breaks the feature into at least 3 separate tasks, not one monolithic task.
Each task has a clear, narrow scope that could be implemented independently.
The output does NOT contain a single task titled 'implement search' that covers everything.
The output orders tasks so dependencies are built first (e.g., search infrastructure before UI).
